basics.name: Arttu Tuominen
basics.label: Software Developer | Quality, Automation & Observability
basics.summary:
Backend developer with about 3 years of professional .NET/C# experience on production systems handling around 1.5M requests a month. For the past year I have worked in my team's quality area. I restored a CI pipeline that had been failing for years, led the move from legacy SQL Server–based logging to OpenTelemetry on Azure, and am the team's go-to person for AI tooling. Studying engineering alongside full-time work.

Download: [CV (EN)](/assets/pdf/arttu_tuominen_cv_en.pdf) · [CV (FI)](/assets/pdf/arttu_tuominen_cv_fi.pdf)

work.name: Saima Soft Oy
work.summary: Backend systems for StaffPoint Oy, including the MyStaff platform.
highlights: Restored a CI pipeline and test suite that had been broken for years by fixing the failing tests and improving the CI process, so every pull request runs automated checks again.

Led the migration from legacy SQL Server–based logging (Elmah) to OpenTelemetry and Azure Application Insights during the move to Azure; set up test and production environments and own release-time monitoring.
Strengthened API security with Cloudflare rate limiting and Postman-based access-control tests that verify authorization rules.
Set up AI agents for the team, including spec-kit and custom MCP agents that sync work between GitHub Copilot and Azure DevOps.
